second.event: The first iPhone goes on sale

rounds.fact: YouTube's first video, "Me at the zoo", went up in April 2005. The iPhone arrived in June 2007.
The Titanic sank in April 1912. The canal opened to ships in August 1914, just after World War I began.

first.event: The Statue of Liberty is dedicated

rounds.fact: Gustave Eiffel's company built the statue's iron skeleton three years before finishing his tower.
Teaching at Oxford is recorded by 1096, more than two centuries before the Aztec capital was founded.

first.event: The Great Pyramid of Giza is completed
first.label: c. 2560 BC

second.event: The last woolly mammoths die out
second.label: c. 2000 BC

rounds.fact: A small group of mammoths survived on Wrangel Island until about 4,000 years ago, centuries after the pyramid went up.

second.event: The oldest surviving photograph is taken
second.label: c. 1826

rounds.fact: Ships first sighted Antarctica in January 1820. Niépce took his "View from the Window at Le Gras" around 1826.

second.event: The first Barbie doll goes on sale

rounds.fact: Disneyland opened in July 1955. Barbie debuted at the American International Toy Fair in March 1959.
Alexander Graham Bell's patent was granted in March 1876. Edison showed off his long-lasting bulb at the end of 1879.

second.event: Leonardo starts painting the Mona Lisa

rounds.fact: Leonardo began the Mona Lisa around 1503, eleven years after Columbus landed in the Caribbean.

second.event: The Taj Mahal's tomb is completed
second.label: c. 1643

rounds.fact: Harvard opened in 1636. Work on the Taj Mahal began in 1632 and the main tomb was finished around 1643.

first.event: American women win the right to vote

second.event: The Ottoman Empire comes to an end

rounds.fact: The 19th Amendment was ratified in August 1920. The Ottoman sultanate was abolished in November 1922.
Shakespeare died in April 1616, four years before the Mayflower reached New England.

first.event: The first Super Bowl is played

rounds.fact: The Green Bay Packers won Super Bowl I in January 1967. Armstrong stepped onto the Moon in July 1969.
Caesar was killed on the Ides of March, 44 BC. Cleopatra died 14 years later, in 30 BC.

second.event: Newton publishes his laws of motion

rounds.fact: Newton's Principia came out in 1687, 21 years after the fire destroyed much of the old city.

second.event: Russia sells Alaska to the U.S.

rounds.fact: The Civil War ended in 1865. The U.S. bought Alaska for $7.2 million two years later.

second.event: Nelson Mandela is freed from prison

rounds.fact: The wall opened in November 1989. Mandela walked free three months later, in February 1990.
Vesuvius erupted in AD 79. Emperor Titus opened the Colosseum the next year with 100 days of games.
Facebook started as TheFacebook in February 2004. The first tweet was sent in March 2006.

second.event: The first Nobel Prizes are awarded

rounds.fact: The modern Olympics began in Athens in 1896. The first Nobel Prizes were handed out in December 1901.
Concorde first flew in March 1969. Queen Elizabeth II opened the Sydney Opera House in October 1973.
Magna Carta was sealed in 1215, while Genghis Khan was still conquering. He died in 1227.
Both dates are traditional, but the Greeks counted the first Olympiad from 776 BC, 23 years before Rome's legendary founding.
Mexico's independence was won in September 1821. Brazil declared its own a year later, in September 1822.

first.event: The World Wide Web goes public

rounds.fact: Tim Berners-Lee opened the web to the public in 1991. Google was founded in a garage seven years later.
The Wrights flew in December 1903. The earthquake struck San Francisco in April 1906.
Napoleon sold Louisiana to the United States in 1803 partly to pay for his wars, which ended at Waterloo in 1815.
The Korean War started in June 1950. Hillary and Tenzing reached the top of Everest in May 1953.
The Bolsheviks took power in November 1917. The first known flu cases were recorded in early 1918.
Constantinople fell in May 1453. Gutenberg's Bible was finished around 1454 to 1455.
Netflix added streaming in January 2007. Instagram launched in October 2010.

first.event: Big Ben's clock starts keeping time

rounds.fact: The Great Clock started in May 1859. The first Underground line opened in January 1863.
President Roosevelt dedicated the Hoover Dam in September 1935. The Golden Gate Bridge opened in May 1937.
Rome had been a republic for nearly two centuries by the time Alexander died in Babylon in 323 BC.
Tree rings show the Vikings were cutting wood at L'Anse aux Meadows in 1021, 45 years before the Battle of Hastings.
The McDonald brothers opened their first restaurant in 1940. Work on Mount Rushmore stopped in October 1941.
Jaws came out in June 1975 and Star Wars in May 1977. Each became the highest-grossing film of its time.
The Suez Canal opened in November 1869. The German Empire was proclaimed at Versailles in January 1871.

first.event: Michelangelo finishes the Sistine Chapel ceiling

second.event: Magellan's expedition completes the first trip around the world

rounds.fact: Michelangelo finished the ceiling in 1512. The one surviving ship of Magellan's fleet returned to Spain in 1522.

first.event: Dolly the sheep is born, the first cloned mammal

second.event: The first Harry Potter book comes out

rounds.fact: Dolly was born in July 1996. Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone was published in June 1997.

second.event: Joan of Arc is burned at the stake

rounds.fact: The alliance that created the Aztec Empire formed in 1428, three years before Joan of Arc died.

first.event: The First Fleet lands in Australia

rounds.fact: British ships arrived at Sydney Cove in January 1788. The Bastille fell in July 1789.

second.event: Euro coins and notes go into circulation

rounds.fact: Wikipedia launched in January 2001. Euro cash arrived exactly a year later, on January 1, 2002.
The Tour de France began in 1903, 27 years before Uruguay hosted and won the first World Cup.
Howard Carter found Tutankhamun's tomb in November 1922. Mickey debuted in Steamboat Willie in 1928.
India became independent in August 1947. Israel declared independence in May 1948.
The Chrysler Building was the world's tallest for less than a year before the Empire State Building opened in May 1931.
England and France were already ten years into their war when the plague arrived in 1347.
Germany reunified in October 1990. The Soviet Union was dissolved in December 1991.

second.event: The Ford Model T goes on sale

rounds.fact: Pharmacist John Pemberton created Coca-Cola in 1886. The Model T came out in 1908.
Sputnik went up in October 1957. Hawaii became the 50th state in August 1959.
Ernő Rubik made his first cube in 1974. Jobs and Wozniak founded Apple in April 1976.

first.event: Ivan the Terrible is crowned tsar

second.event: The Spanish Armada sails for England

rounds.fact: Ivan became Russia's first tsar in 1547. The Armada set sail 41 years later.
Marco Polo came home from China in 1295. Mansa Musa's famously rich trip through Cairo came in 1324.

second.event: The first iPod goes on sale

rounds.fact: James Cameron's Titanic was released in December 1997. Apple's first iPod came out in October 2001.
Gold was found at Sutter's Mill in January 1848. Lincoln won the election in November 1860.
Napoleon was crowned in December 1804. Beethoven's Fifth premiered in December 1808.

first.event: The Hubble Space Telescope is launched

rounds.fact: Hubble launched in April 1990. The Channel Tunnel opened in May 1994.

second.event: Yellowstone becomes the first national park

rounds.fact: Chicago burned in October 1871. Yellowstone was made a national park in March 1872.

second.event: Work begins on Notre-Dame de Paris

rounds.fact: Angkor Wat was built under King Suryavarman II, who ruled from 1113 to about 1150. Notre-Dame was begun in 1163.

first.event: The Beatles release their first album

rounds.fact: Please Please Me came out in March 1963. Woodstock took place in August 1969.

second.event: The first Pokémon games come out

rounds.fact: Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film, came out in November 1995. Pokémon Red and Green launched in Japan in February 1996.

first.event: Edo, today's Tokyo, becomes Japan's seat of power

rounds.fact: Tokugawa Ieyasu made Edo the seat of his shogunate in 1603, 17 years before the Mayflower arrived.

first.event: Captain Cook reaches Australia's east coast

second.event: The Declaration of Independence is signed

rounds.fact: Cook landed at Botany Bay in April 1770. The Declaration was adopted in July 1776.

second.event: The first Kodak camera goes on sale

rounds.fact: Krakatoa exploded in August 1883. George Eastman's first Kodak camera went on sale in 1888.

first.event: Work begins on the Leaning Tower of Pisa

rounds.fact: Building of the tower began in 1173. Saladin took Jerusalem in October 1187.
Motorola's Martin Cooper made the first handheld cellphone call in April 1973. Pac-Man arrived in arcades in 1980.

second.event: The Battle of the Little Bighorn

rounds.fact: The first Kentucky Derby was run in May 1875. Custer's last stand came in June 1876.
Nintendo began as a maker of playing cards in 1889. Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays in 1895.

second.event: Vatican City becomes its own country

rounds.fact: Alexander Fleming noticed penicillin in September 1928. The Lateran Treaty created Vatican City in February 1929.

first.event: Iceland's parliament, the Althing, first meets

second.event: Otto I is crowned Holy Roman Emperor

rounds.fact: The Althing first met in 930, making it one of the world's oldest parliaments.

first.event: Vasco da Gama reaches India by sea

rounds.fact: Da Gama reached India in May 1498. Luther's 95 Theses came 19 years later, in 1517.
Sony released the PlayStation in Japan in December 1994. Windows 95 launched in August 1995.
Lego patented its modern interlocking brick in January 1958. Fidel Castro took power in January 1959.

second.event: Amelia Earhart flies solo across the Atlantic

rounds.fact: The stock market crashed in October 1929. Earhart landed in Northern Ireland in May 1932.

second.event: Washington, D.C. becomes the U.S. capital

rounds.fact: French soldiers found the Rosetta Stone in July 1799. Congress first met in Washington in November 1800.
China's first emperor finished unifying the country in 221 BC. Hannibal marched his elephants over the Alps in 218 BC.
Amundsen reached the pole on December 14, 1911. The Republic of China was proclaimed on January 1, 1912.
Jeff Bezos founded Amazon in July 1994 as an online bookstore. eBay started in September 1995.
Franklin flew his kite in a thunderstorm in 1752. Mozart was born in January 1756.
Mount St. Helens erupted in May 1980. MTV started broadcasting in August 1981.

first.event: The White Tower of London is begun
first.label: c. 1078

rounds.fact: William the Conqueror started the White Tower around 1078, almost 20 years before the First Crusade.

first.event: Pizarro captures the Inca emperor Atahualpa

second.event: Henry VIII breaks from the Pope

rounds.fact: Atahualpa was captured in November 1532. England's Act of Supremacy passed in 1534.
The Terracotta Army was buried with China's first emperor around 210 BC. Rome beat Hannibal at Zama in 202 BC.
